projects.name: Sallah bot
projects.description: A Telegram bot written in Python that sends prayer-time reminders for the user's city, used by about 1,200 people. Runs on a self-managed Ubuntu server accessed via SSH. Stores user data in SQLite with hand-written tables and queries. Fixed a time-zone bug causing late Fajr reminders and added a safeguard to prevent recurrence.
